strengths: Clear, accurate WCAG 2.2 normative versus non-normative boundary and precise differentiation across Level A SC 1.2.3, Level AA SC 1.2.5, Level AAA SC 1.2.7, and the synchronized-media definitional exclusion (not_applicable).

Faithful explanation of G78, G173 combined with G226, G203 as a narrowly scoped in-scope pass path rather than a definitional exclusion or general text-alternative shortcut, and F113 pause evaluation (length, proximity, essential non-speech audio preservation, no rigid 2-second threshold).

Disciplined evidence and provenance hygiene: preserves the intentionally inconclusive overall actual_decision, distinguishes the single native Gemini media observation from the three derived GPT evidence reviews and 24 conditional scenario matches via <!-- verified-report -->, avoids treating muted browser playback or absent Chromium audioTracks API as proof, and explicitly marks proposed 12-16s narration as unproduced and unmeasured.

Effective teaching depth across the six-scene recovery code walkthrough, contrasting missing failure/re-authentication semantics at 12-15s (with alert-beep preservation) against meaning-level omission of the training-only notice at 20-26s rather than mechanical readout of dummy code R7K2-P9M4.

Consistent four-language equivalence across ko, en, ja, and zh for manuscript structure, localized figure titles/captions/alt text across all four figure types (paths, storyboard, scene_compare, timing), lab iframe/navigation URLs, and the frozen v0.3.1 evaluation prompt.
limits: Review was conducted strictly on provided text, JSON, DOM snapshot, and audit metadata artifacts without listening to source.mp4 or visually inspecting extracted video frames.

Rendered visual layout, typography, and potential text wrapping or clipping of longer figure labels (such as timing.labels.pause across all four languages) could not be verified without rendered figure graphics.

Evidence verification is bounded to the provided local fixture 1.0.2 initial-state DOM captures, ffprobe metadata, browser muted-playback log, W3C source extracts, and audit records; live production deployment states and external OS/player track-selection paths remain unreviewed.
